title: What changed: the script channel
description: How an agent's terminal gets the right to drive the editor

steps.title: The verb an agent runs
steps.explanation: `fresh --cmd script run` reads the program from a file or from standard input and hands it to the running editor.

steps.title: Where the authority comes from
steps.explanation: A workspace hands its agent the ability to drive the editor when it starts it, bound to that workspace and nothing else. Nothing else in the process gets it by default.

steps.title: The check, and the target
steps.explanation: Each script names a token. The editor looks it up, refuses one that may not script, and runs the program against the window the token was minted for.
